title: Sun helioseismic p-mode row
description: One helioseismic p-mode at canonical (n, l) labels in the Sun's dynamical decomposition. Single row_type catalogue ('helioseismic_mode'); the row_type field is retained for consistency with the multi-row-type Mercury / Luna / Mars descriptors, even though all rows in this catalogue share the same type.

name.description: Composite row identifier 'n<radial_order>_l<spherical_harmonic_degree>' (e.g., 'n18_l0', 'n21_l2'). Sufficient to uniquely identify a p-mode in this slice of the comb.

row_type.description: Row category. Single value in this catalogue ('helioseismic_mode'); the field is retained for symmetry with the multi-row-type planetary catalogues. Future extension might add 'g_mode' / 'f_mode' / 'mixed_mode' rows.

n.description: Radial order. Number of pressure-pressure crossings in the radial eigenfunction inside the Sun. The catalogue's slice spans n=18 through n=25 — the high-SNR portion of the BiSON comb.

l.description: Spherical-harmonic degree (angular structure). l=0 = radial; l=1 = dipole; l=2 = quadrupole. The catalogue ships l=0, 1, 2 (low-degree global modes resolvable by sun-as-a-star instruments).

frequency_uhz.description: Mode frequency ν_{n,l} in microhertz. Positive by definition; m=0 (zonal) frequency — rotation-induced m-splitting (~430 nHz) is not represented in this catalogue.

mode_class.description: Mode physics class. p-mode = pressure-driven acoustic; g-mode = buoyancy-driven gravity; f-mode = surface fundamental; mixed = avoided-crossing mode. All catalogue rows are 'p'.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For BiSON / SOI-MDI / SDO-HMI release tags or catalogue versions.
